sections.title: ML Consulting Services in New York
sections.description: Engineering-credible AI advisory for New York's enterprise and regulated industries.

items.title: AI Strategy and Roadmap Development
items.description: ClickMasters produces AI roadmaps for New York enterprises that are technically executable — not PowerPoint slide decks from teams who've never validated a model in production. Every ClickMasters AI strategy engagement includes: use case prioritization by ROI potential and data feasibility (the combination matters — high ROI from a use case your data can't support isn't a priority); technology stack recommendations with specific rationale for your infrastructure and team; build vs. buy analysis for each use case, with vendor evaluation where buy is recommended; realistic timeline and cost estimates (not aspirational roadmap slides); data readiness assessment per use case; organizational capability gap analysis and team-building recommendations. Cost: $30,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 6–10 weeks.
items.label: AI Strategy

items.title: ML Model Validation and Audit
items.description: Independent technical review of existing or proposed ML models for New York's financial, healthcare, and regulated-industry clients. ClickMasters model validation delivers: statistical validation against representative test datasets; feature importance analysis and proxy variable screening (FCRA and fair lending); performance benchmarking against appropriate baselines; documentation meeting SR 26-2 Federal Reserve / OCC model risk management requirements; backtesting results for time-series models; monitoring design recommendations. Cost: $20,000–$65,000 | Timeline: 4–10 weeks | SR 26-2 documentation standard for NY banking.
items.label: Model Validation

items.title: MLOps Architecture Advisory
items.description: Evaluating existing ML infrastructure or designing new MLOps architecture for New York's data science teams — experiment tracking, model registry, CI/CD for ML, drift monitoring, and retraining pipeline design. ClickMasters delivers architectural recommendations with vendor comparison, implementation cost estimates, and migration path from current state. Cost: $15,000–$50,000 | Timeline: 3–8 weeks.
items.label: MLOps Advisory

items.title: AI Vendor Evaluation
items.description: Independent assessment of AI vendor proposals, platform capabilities, and pricing for New York organizations evaluating LLM providers, MLOps platforms, AI SaaS tools, and development agency capabilities. ClickMasters evaluates vendors against your specific technical requirements and commercial terms — cutting through vendor marketing with engineering assessment. Cost: $10,000–$30,000 | Timeline: 2–5 weeks.
items.label: Vendor Evaluation

items.title: Fractional Chief AI Officer
items.description: Senior ClickMasters AI architects providing ongoing advisory — attending executive meetings, advising on AI investment decisions, reviewing AI project proposals, and representing AI strategy to board and investors. Particularly valuable for New York companies scaling AI programs without yet justifying a full-time CAO hire. Rate: From $8,000/month | Engagement minimum: 3 months.
items.label: Fractional CAO

items.title: AI Readiness Assessment
items.description: Comprehensive assessment of your organization's readiness for AI — data infrastructure evaluation, team capability audit, technology stack review, regulatory compliance gap analysis, and prioritized recommendations. Cost: $15,000–$55,000 | Timeline: 4–8 weeks.
items.label: Readiness Assessment

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.description: Common questions from New York organizations about ML consulting with ClickMasters.

items.question: Does ClickMasters provide conflict-of-interest-free vendor evaluation?
items.answer: Yes — ClickMasters has no reseller or referral relationship with any AI platform vendor or cloud provider. Vendor evaluations reflect your requirements exclusively.

items.question: Can ML consulting help us communicate AI strategy to our New York board?
items.answer: Yes — board-ready AI strategy communication with ROI framing, risk disclosure, and competitive positioning is a standard component of ClickMasters' AI Strategy and Roadmap engagements.

items.question: Does ClickMasters consulting result in actionable deliverables?
items.answer: Every ClickMasters consulting engagement delivers a specific, executable artifact — roadmap with cost estimates, model validation report with documentation, architectural design with implementation guidance. Not slide decks with generic recommendations.

items.question: Can ClickMasters evaluate an AI development agency proposal we've received?
items.answer: Yes — ClickMasters evaluates whether a vendor's proposed technical approach is appropriate for your use case and whether pricing is market-appropriate, providing an independent technical second opinion.

items.question: How long does ML consulting take to start in New York?
items.answer: Hourly and fractional advisory: 1–2 weeks from engagement start. Fixed-price strategy engagements: begin within 2 weeks of contract signing.

items.question: Does consulting eventually lead to development with ClickMasters?
items.answer: Often, but not required. ClickMasters consulting is delivered honestly regardless of whether the recommendation supports further ClickMasters development engagement. If the best recommendation for your situation is a different path, we say so.
